_policy: Tracking skeleton for the specification's unreleased `draft` revision (docs/specification/draft/ upstream): data, not a judged revision. It has the shape of a dated revision's sources.json so the next revision starts from it: `in_scope` maps each page to its source file under docs/specification/draft/, `out_of_scope` gives every excluded page its reason, and the three censuses count each in-scope page's RFC 2119 keywords as last read. Nothing loads it into a verdict: the core crate embeds registry documents by an explicit list that names no file here, `draft` is not a protocol revision `--revision` accepts, the directory is excluded from the published package, and it holds no requirement entries. `cargo xtask spec-drift --draft` compares it, informationally, with the live draft (page set, census, and whether each released `2026-07-28` quote is still on its draft page), and `cargo xtask page-set` holds its shape offline like any revision's. The lists mirror `2026-07-28`'s decisions until a draft change gives a reason to re-decide one. When the draft is cut as a dated revision, this directory becomes that revision's (docs/plan/03-conformance-strategy.md, How the next revision starts).

out_of_scope.architecture/index: No RFC 2119 keyword instances on the draft page (checked 2026-10-13); out at 2026-07-28 for the same reason.
out_of_scope.basic/authorization/authorization-server: Full OAuth flows — the same boundary the registry's TRAN-009 exclusion records at 2025-11-25, with the suite's auth/* scenarios deferred under the `auth-client-scenarios` ledger row.
out_of_scope.changelog: Non-normative revision history; on the draft, the post-release stub until changes accumulate.
out_of_scope.deprecated: Registry of features in the Deprecated lifecycle state. Its two keywords (new implementations SHOULD NOT adopt a deprecated feature; existing ones SHOULD migrate before its earliest removal) bind an implementer's adoption plans, not anything a trace carries: strategy rule 2 (checked against the draft 2026-10-13).
out_of_scope.index: Landing page: keyword instances are the BCP 14 boilerplate plus security-principles guidance about consent and authorization flows — UI and internal policy, out by strategy rule 2.
out_of_scope.schema: Generated schema reference: constraints stated only in schema field documentation without RFC 2119 keywords are excluded by strategy rule 3.
out_of_scope.server/index: Overview page: no RFC 2119 keyword instances on the draft page (checked 2026-10-13); the capability MUSTs live on the per-feature pages.

_census_policy: The same three censuses, counted the same way as at 2026-07-28 (frontmatter and fenced code excluded, table rows included, uppercase only), of the live draft text as last read. A move here is not a failure: `cargo xtask spec-drift --draft` reports it beside the `2026-07-28` committed number, so a reader sees what the next revision changes. Update a number once the move is read, and record a reworded released clause in post-release.json.
